name: Castle early
description: Get the king safe and connect the rooks.

lessons.prompt: Your e4 pawn is attacked, but you do not need to defend it yet. Get your king safe.
hints: If ...Nxe4, a rook on e1 wins the pawn back.
lessons.explanation: 5.O-O is the main line. If 5...Nxe4, 6.Re1 (or 6.d4) wins the pawn back with a lead in development, because the e-file opens toward Black’s king.

lessons.prompt: Your pieces are out. Finish development the right way.
hints: Your king is still in the center.
lessons.explanation: 8...O-O completes Black’s development: the king is safe and the f8 rook can join the game. This is the main line of the Closed Ruy Lopez.

lessons.prompt: A quiet Italian. Before anything else, tuck your king away.
lessons.explanation: 5.O-O (5.c3 is equally good) is standard. With the king castled, White can later play c3, Re1 and d4 without worrying about checks on the e-file.

lessons.prompt: Queen’s Gambit Declined. Your kingside is ready.
hints: The e7 bishop has broken the pin.
lessons.explanation: 5...O-O is the main line: the king goes to safety first, then Black picks a plan with ...Nbd7, ...c6 or ...b6.

hints: Your king and rook are ready.
lessons.explanation: 5...O-O mirrors White and keeps the king out of trouble. 5...d6 is equally good; both lead to the slow Giuoco Pianissimo.
